a: `solveForX` gives up after 12 bisection steps, so a curve where Newton bails is only solved to ~2^-12, far short of its own 1e-7 epsilon
`bezierCubic.discriminators` offers an `out` handle on the last anchor and an `in` handle on the first, and neither is used by any segment
b: 3D `invert` returns a matrix with NaN/Infinity translation for an affine input with non-finite translation; 2D `invert` returns null
`pathCrossings` reports the closing joint of a one-cubic closed subpath as a self-crossing
`pointAtLength` at a run's start falls back to a neighboring curve's chord rather than its tangent
